property_summary: For every admissible input, after Put(t) the stored unlock time satisfies Acc[msg.sender].unlockTime >= block.timestamp (Put never sets a past unlock time); the mutant stores _unlockTime verbatim, so any t < block.timestamp breaks the rule.
change_summary: Always set the unlock time to _unlockTime, even when it is in the past, so Acc[msg.sender].unlockTime after Put differs.
